instruction: Fix `count_occurrences` to count only non-overlapping occurrences and to handle an empty substring. It currently advances one character at a time even after a match and has no empty-substring guard.
gold_patch:
diff --git a/textutils.py b/textutils.py
--- a/textutils.py
+++ b/textutils.py
@@ -61,10 +61,14 @@
 
 def count_occurrences(text, sub):
     """Count non-overlapping occurrences of ``sub`` in ``text``."""
+    if not sub:
+        return 0
     count = 0
     i = 0
     while i < len(text):
         if text.startswith(sub, i):
             count += 1
-        i += 1
+            i += len(sub)
+        else:
+            i += 1
     return count
